svg.font-family: Nunito, Inter, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Your prompt is the start of the text
svg.desc: Four cards: the model reads everything in the window (earlier messages, files, your message); your words tilt the odds of each next token; reasoning models write rough-work tokens before the answer; a checkable definition of done tells it when to stop. A loop arrow shows the next message re-sending all of it.

g.text: Your prompt is the start of the text
The model continues it one token at a time, re-reading all of it on every turn.
a finish line it can check
“How will I know it is done?”
next message: all of it is sent again
